description: Java class containing Swagger API documentation and schema definitions for Self Account Transfer API endpoints in the Fineract project.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container for Swagger schema definitions related to self account transfer API, including request and response models.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.GetAccountTransferTemplateResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response template when retrieving account transfer options.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.GetAccountTransferTemplateResponse.GetAccountOptions
classes.description: Model representing account options with id, code, and description.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.GetAccountTransferTemplateResponse.GetFromAccountOptions
classes.description: Model detailing a 'from' account's information, including account number, type, client, and office details.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.GetAccountTransferTemplateResponse.GetToAccountOptions
classes.description: Model detailing a 'to' account's information, similar to 'from' account options.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.PostNewTransferRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new transfer request, including account IDs, amounts, dates, locale, and descriptions.

classes.name: SelfAccountTransferApiResourceSwagger.PostNewTransferResponse
classes.description: Schema representing the response after a transfer, including savings and resource IDs.

methods.name: <init>
methods.description: Private constructor to prevent instantiation of the class.
